sub: What your students receive when they buy. Change the subject and the message as you like: the receipt with the purchase details always goes below.
errorCargar: We could not load the emails. Reload the page.

purchase_receipt.cuando: When someone pays for a course or starts a membership. It carries the button to get in.

purchase_renewal_receipt.cuando: Every time a subscription is charged.

purchase_payment_failed.cuando: When the bank declines a renewal charge.

purchase_refund.cuando: When you give back the money of a sale.

idiomaAyuda: Each student gets it in their language. If you sell in several languages, check the text of each one.
datosAyuda: It is replaced by each student's real detail when sent.
reciboFijo: The receipt (order, amount, payment method, who sells and the withdrawal waiver) always goes below your message and cannot be removed.
guardado: Saved. The next emails will go out like this.
pruebaEnviada: We have sent a test to {email}. If it does not arrive, check your spam folder.
originalConfirmar: Go back to the original text of “{nombre}” in {idioma}? What you wrote will be lost.
errorVista: We could not prepare the preview.
errorGuardar: We could not save it. Please try again.
errorPrueba: We could not send the test.
politicaAyuda: If you have a page with your refund policy, paste the link here and it will appear on every receipt.
politicaInvalida: Paste a link that starts with https://
